title: Brush Max… If You Dare!
summary: Brush a feisty black cat, watch his warning signs, and let go before he chomps the brush.
description: A grungy photo-collage timing game about grooming Max carefully and respecting a cat's body language.

safety.privacy: Local-only play using repo-local images of Max; no accounts, chat, sharing, tracking, or saved data.
safety.adultHelp: None required for ordinary play; an adult can reinforce that real cats should be given space when they show discomfort.
safety.notes: Includes a comic bite directed at the grooming brush, with no injury or lost progress. Warnings use motion, text, shape, and color together, so optional synthesized cues and local purr-and-hiss clips are never required. An always-visible mute button is provided.
